newsitem.title: USA: Crown Crafts sees better business conditions.
newsitem.headline: Crown Crafts sees better business conditions.

text.p: Crown Crafts Inc said Wednesday business conditions and the retailing climate seem to have improved this year.
The company also said it believes it will see in fiscal 1998 "significant progress" toward its goal of restoring profits to their historical levels.
The company reported a loss per share for the first quarter of $0.02 compared to a loss of $0.17 for the same period a year ago.
The company said first quarter sales growth was driven by infant and juvenile products which increased by more than 50 percent.
This growth is consistent with its goal of growing infant and juvenile products to about one-third of total business.
Adult bedcoverings also registered sales increases of nearly 18 percent compared to the first quarter of fiscal 1997.
The company said its first fiscal quarter is historically a period of disproportionately low sales of throws, and sales of throws declined during the quarter.
For the balance of fiscal 1998, however, it said sales of adult and infant throws should recover to last year's levels.
